qualification.details: Dance Expert: Certificate/Diploma in any of the Indian Classical/Folk Dance from a recognized university. TGT (CS): Bachelor's Degree in Computer Applications (BCA) with at least 50% marks OR Graduation in Computer Science/IT with 50% marks OR BE/B.Tech (CS/IT) with 50% marks; CTET (Paper-II) qualified; B.Ed or integrated B.Ed-M.Ed or four years integrated degree with 50% marks from NCTE recognized institution. TGT (Art): Bachelor's degree in Drawing and Painting/Sculpture/Graphic Art/Fine Arts with at least 50% marks (Drawing and Painting as main subject); B.Ed Degree from NCTE recognized institution with at least 50% marks. Hostel Superintendent: Graduation in any discipline; desirable Master's/B.Ed; proficiency in regional language; minimum 03 years experience in pay level 3 or above or 07 years on consolidated pay not less than Rs. 29,000/- in a recognized residential school or ex-defence with 07 years experience.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date for the Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview for the Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya recruitment is scheduled for 30 September 2026. Candidates should ensure they report to the venue on this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies announced for various posts including Dance Expert, TGT (CS), TGT (Art), and Hostel Superintendent.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for TGT (CS) post?
faq.answer: For the TGT (CS) post, candidates need a Bachelor's Degree in Computer Applications (BCA) or Graduation in Computer Science/IT with 50% marks, along with CTET Paper-II and B.Ed.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the posts?
faq.answer: The age limit for all the posts is between a minimum of 18 years and a maximum of 50 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Hostel Superintendent post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Hostel Superintendent post will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 35,750/-.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for these positions?
faq.answer: The mode of application is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly at the specified venue and time.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, and category certificates (if applicable).

faq.question: Q9. Where is the Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya located for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya in Banaskantha, Gujarat, with the pincode 385505.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process will be based on a Walk-in Interview. Candidates are advised to prepare well for the interview.
